predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: Chios, which Benedetto I Zaccaria 'reconquered... in 1304'

successors.name: Byzantine Empire
successors.text: Chios, from which the locals expelled the Zaccaria in 1329 (Chios page) when Andronikos III arrived with 105 vessels; Samos and Kos: page silent

ledger.x: 1325: Martino's reach grows to Samos and Kos.
1329: the Zaccaria lordship of Chios ends.

wars.name: Byzantine reconquest of Chios
wars.outcome: Andronikos III sailed to Chios in autumn 1329 with 105 vessels; Martino Zaccaria refused a garrison and tribute, was besieged in his citadel and surrendered; the emperor made Kalothetos governor.

certainty.note: An island lordship: the coast is the border; Samos and Kos are listed on one page with no dates.
